files.description: The complete EHI export documentation for Office Ally EHR 24/7 — a single-page PDF describing four export components: C-CDA XML (USCDI v1), Appointments CSV, Claims CSV, and Attachments in original format. No data dictionary, no field definitions, no sample data. Version 1.0.1, dated 2024-02-08.
Full-page browser screenshot of the ONC ACB Certification page showing the Electronic Health Information Export section with the single PDF link.
